lines.text: Hi, and welcome to this lesson on your future-you resume.
lines.narration: Hi, and welcome to this lesson on your future-you resume.

lines.text: By mid-career, most of us have resumes that have quietly turned into archives — long lists of everything we've ever done.
lines.narration: By mid-career, most of us have resumes that have quietly turned into archives — long lists of everything we've ever done.

lines.text: On the surface that looks thorough.
lines.narration: On the surface that looks thorough.

lines.text: In practice, it often works against us.
lines.narration: In practice, it often works against us.

lines.text: So today, let's see your resume differently: not as a historical record, but as a strategic tool that tells the story of where you're going next, and why you're ready for it.
lines.narration: So today, let's see your resume differently: not as a historical record, but as a strategic tool that tells the story of where you're going next, and why you're ready for it.

lines.text: Let's start with why so many mid-career resumes don't do us justice.
lines.narration: Let's start with why so many mid-career resumes don't do us justice.

lines.text: There are three usual culprits.
lines.narration: There are three usual culprits.

lines.text: First, they're overloaded with tasks but light on impact.
lines.narration: First, they're overloaded with tasks but light on impact.

lines.text: You'll see bullets like "Managed projects," "Supported faculty," "Handled student inquiries."
lines.narration: You'll see bullets like "Managed projects," "Supported faculty," "Handled student inquiries."

lines.text: Those describe activity, but they don't tell anyone what changed because you were in the role — no results, no scope, no value added.
lines.narration: Those describe activity, but they don't tell anyone what changed because you were in the role — no results, no scope, no value added.

lines.text: Second, the format and language feel outdated or generic.
lines.narration: Second, the format and language feel outdated or generic.

lines.text: We carry old sections forward and keep phrases we wrote a decade ago, never checking whether the document matches today's expectations.
lines.narration: We carry old sections forward and keep phrases we wrote a decade ago, never checking whether the document matches today's expectations.

lines.text: The result looks busy but not sharp or focused.
lines.narration: The result looks busy but not sharp or focused.

lines.text: Third — and this is the big one for us — there's often no clear link between your experience and the role you want next.
lines.narration: Third — and this is the big one for us — there's often no clear link between your experience and the role you want next.

lines.text: Someone can read what you've done, but not see how it connects to the step you want next.
lines.narration: Someone can read what you've done, but not see how it connects to the step you want next.

lines.text: There's no through-line from "here's my history" to "here's why I'm ready for this."
lines.narration: There's no through-line from "here's my history" to "here's why I'm ready for this."

lines.text: All of that makes it harder for hiring managers, sponsors, and decision-makers to say: "Yes, this person is clearly the right fit, right now."
lines.narration: All of that makes it harder for hiring managers, sponsors, and decision-makers to say: "Yes, this person is clearly the right fit, right now."

lines.text: So let's flip the perspective.
lines.narration: So let's flip the perspective.

lines.text: At this stage, your resume is less about proving you've been busy and more about showing you're ready for what's next.
lines.narration: At this stage, your resume is less about proving you've been busy and more about showing you're ready for what's next.

lines.text: A future-you resume is built around the role you want, not the role you started in.
lines.narration: A future-you resume is built around the role you want, not the role you started in.

lines.text: Instead of documenting everything, you're curating evidence — choosing the projects, results, and responsibilities that best support the direction you've already defined in this course.
lines.narration: Instead of documenting everything, you're curating evidence — choosing the projects, results, and responsibilities that best support the direction you've already defined in this course.

lines.text: Every bullet answers one question: "How does this show I'm prepared for my next move?"
lines.narration: Every bullet answers one question: "How does this show I'm prepared for my next move?"

lines.text: That might mean highlighting the initiatives where you led at a higher level than your title suggested.
lines.narration: That might mean highlighting the initiatives where you led at a higher level than your title suggested.

lines.text: Emphasizing outcomes and scope — how many people you impacted, what improved.
lines.narration: Emphasizing outcomes and scope — how many people you impacted, what improved.

lines.text: And de-emphasizing tasks or roles that no longer match where you're heading.
lines.narration: And de-emphasizing tasks or roles that no longer match where you're heading.

lines.text: Your resume becomes less of a timeline and more of a case file for your future you.
lines.narration: Your resume becomes less of a timeline and more of a case file for your future you.

lines.text: Earlier in this track, you created a Next Move Statement.
lines.narration: Earlier in this track, you created a Next Move Statement.

lines.text: You named your primary path — promotion, lateral move, or role redesign — and described the role you want in the next 6 to 12 months.
lines.narration: You named your primary path — promotion, lateral move, or role redesign — and described the role you want in the next 6 to 12 months.

lines.text: In this lesson, that statement is your north star.
lines.narration: In this lesson, that statement is your north star.

lines.text: As you update your resume, you'll ask of every line: "Does this help make the case for the role in my Next Move Statement?"
lines.narration: As you update your resume, you'll ask of every line: "Does this help make the case for the role in my Next Move Statement?"

lines.text: You'll choose three to five experiences that serve as your strongest evidence.
lines.narration: You'll choose three to five experiences that serve as your strongest evidence.

lines.text: And you'll rewrite them to clearly show responsibility, action, measurable outcome, and scope.
lines.narration: And you'll rewrite them to clearly show responsibility, action, measurable outcome, and scope.

lines.text: For example, instead of "Managed team projects," you might write: "Led a cross-functional team of 6 to streamline onboarding, reducing time-to-productivity by 30% and improving new-hire satisfaction scores by 20%."
lines.narration: For example, instead of "Managed team projects," you might write: "Led a cross-functional team of 6 to streamline onboarding, reducing time-to-productivity by 30% and improving new-hire satisfaction scores by 20%."

lines.text: Same person, same work — but the second version paints a much clearer picture of your impact and your readiness for more.
lines.narration: Same person, same work — but the second version paints a much clearer picture of your impact and your readiness for more.

lines.text: From here, you'll use our Resume Builder Tool to upload or paste parts of your current resume, let AI help you draft stronger, impact-focused bullets, and refine the versions that best support your Next Move Statement.
lines.narration: From here, you'll use our Resume Builder Tool to upload or paste parts of your current resume, let AI help you draft stronger, impact-focused bullets, and refine the versions that best support your Next Move Statement.

lines.text: You'll decide which three to five experiences become your headline stories on your resume and profile.
lines.narration: You'll decide which three to five experiences become your headline stories on your resume and profile.

lines.text: When you're ready, click Next to begin working with the Resume Builder Tool, and start reshaping your resume around the role you want, not just the roles you've had.
